protocol.name: livi_transparent_region_v1
protocol.copyright: Part of LIVI, GNU General Public License version 3 or later (LICENSE).
protocol.description: The counterpart of wl_surface.set_opaque_region: a client says where its surface is fully transparent, so that the compositor may leave the surface out there instead of blending it over what lies below. LIVI's UI lies over the video of a phone or a camera and draws nothing over most of it; blending it there costs a pass over the whole video for each video frame.

interface.name: livi_transparent_region_manager_v1
interface.description: A global; the compositor offers it only when it uses what it is told.

description.summary: the regions made with it stay

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the surface has a transparent region object already

request.name: get_transparent_region

description.summary: the transparent region of a surface

request.description: At most one for a surface; a second one is the protocol error already_exists.

interface.name: livi_transparent_region_v1
interface.description: Double-buffered state of a wl_surface, applied with the next wl_surface.commit, like the opaque region.

description.summary: the region goes away with the next commit

request.name: set_region

description.summary: where the surface is fully transparent

request.description: The area of the surface, in surface-local coordinates, in which every pixel of the buffer committed with it is zero in all four components. The compositor may leave the surface out there; a client that names a pixel it draws on loses that pixel. The region stays until the next set_region. Null, as at the start, is none. The region is copied: the wl_region may be destroyed right after.
